findings: Label, caption, status dan tombol operasional sebelumnya banyak memakai font 8–11px.
Layout berbasis desktop dan breakpoint nonstandar; sidebar mobile custom tanpa fokus modal.
Grid slider dipaksa 5/4 kolom walaupun ruang container terlalu sempit.
Tabel, form filter, tombol export dan pagination memerlukan pembatasan/wrapping yang konsisten.
Gaya table/th/td global mengganggu ukuran kalender Ant Design; kini scoped ke tabel data.
Dialog custom belum memiliki focus trap/Escape; diganti Modal Ant Design.
Grafik memakai label 10px dan belum memiliki kontrol sensor dengan keyboard.
Resize tanda tangan perlu memperhitungkan DPR dan menjaga koordinat serta ukuran goresan setelah rotasi.

design.fontFamily: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif (existing system font; no external font request)

interactions: Chiller slider ArrowUp keeps a numeric 0.1 step
DatePicker and TimePicker fit inside 320x568 viewport
User invite/edit modal, role Popconfirm and dropdown fit mobile without submitting changes
Report approval modal and PDF preview container fit mobile
Chart sensor toggle works with Enter
Signature drawn with mouse, previewed, rotated 320->768->320; PNG before/after identical

limits: Browser verification uses actual client components with isolated fixtures, not an authenticated Google session or operational spreadsheet data.
AuthFrame is shared by login/register/pending/account-status; legacy login and registration-complete were source-audited. Server-only redirects have no independent UI.
Existing pending route is /pending, not /pending-approval; report detail is an inline preview/approval, not a separate page route.
Google OAuth login/logout, live Sheets writes and production domain were not exercised. API/auth/permission/schema/PDF-generation code was not changed.
Touch layouts and touch-action were checked through browser emulation/layout; a physical touchscreen and formal assistive-technology/WCAG audit were not used.
